'''Siswai''' is a horse owned by [[Aviendha]]. In the [[Old Tongue]], Siswai meens "spear."

==Appearance==
Siswai is an arch-necked gray mare.

==Activities==
Siswai carries Aviendha back to [[Caemlyn]], to the Queen's Stableyard, after meeting with [[House Matherin]].{{ref/book|10|10}}{{ref/book|10|11}}
